Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

Hi Marissa / team —

Short answers below — please feel free to redact internal contact info before sending externally. Happy to jump on a call with Lina if needed.

1) SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in Sept 2025. We can provide a redacted SOC 2 report excerpt for vendor reviews. Full report delivery is gated by NDA; we typically exchange the full report via secure share under NDA. (Attachment: SOC2-report-redacted-2025.pdf)

2) EU Data Residency: Hosted API: We support EU-only tenancy in eu-west-1 (Ireland) and eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). By default, metadata/telemetry is aggregated for product analytics, but for enterprise customers we can configure telemetry to remain in-region and disable cross-region backups. Private Dedicated/Private deployments give you full control and can be deployed inside your VPC to keep all data in-region. We can provide an attestation letter from infra ops confirming configuration for an EU-only deployment.

3) Cross-border transfers: We rely on contractual safeguards including SCCs for data transfers. If you require no cross-border transfer at all, Private deployment is the recommended path. We can also scope a contract clause to explicitly prohibit cross-border backups.

4) OFAC / Export controls / ITAR: We perform sanctions screening on new accounts and block provision for sanctioned entities (OFAC/Treasury list). We are not set up for ITAR-controlled workloads by default — ITAR introduces export licensing complexities and would require a dedicated compliance engagement with Legal and Ops. If Medisys expects ITAR material, we should escalate to legal to scope requirements.

5) HIPAA / BAA: We support HIPAA workflows and will sign a BAA. Typical turnaround for a standard redline is 1–2 weeks once legal scope and contact are confirmed.
